one_line: A hereditary Pardhan bard from Gondwana, keeper of Gond kings’ memories and creation songs through his kingri and voice.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, slim but wiry from long travel and performance.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones and a softly square jaw, medium-brown central Indian complexion, straight nose, expressive dark eyes with slightly thick brows, a small tilak-like smear of ash or ochre on the forehead, default expression calm and attentive with a hint of a storyteller’s smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied back into a low, neat knot at the nape (no topknot), with a simple narrow off-white cloth band tied around the head like a soft headband; a few short strands escape at the temples.
appearance.costume: A knee-length, side-tied cotton tunic (kurta) in warm off-white with hand-embroidered narrow dark-red running-stitch borders at the neck, cuffs and hem; over it, a soft, unbleached cotton angavastra-style shawl with a muted indigo edge draped from the left shoulder across the chest and wrapped once around the torso; below, a plain handwoven dark indigo dhoti worn above the ankles, neatly pleated in front and tied at the waist; simple brown leather sandals; light wooden bead necklace and a thin brass bangle on the right wrist; a small cloth waist-pouch in dull red tied by a cord at his right hip.
appearance.signature: A three-stringed bamboo kingri held carefully in his left hand, with a small resonator gourd, natural light-brown wood body, a dark-polished wooden fingerboard, and a bow of slightly darker wood with pale horsehair, plus a rolled palm-leaf-wrapped bundle of story-tokens tucked into his shawl.

ref_desc: A medium-brown, oval-faced Pardhan bard with black hair in a low knot and a cloth headband, wearing an off-white embroidered tunic, indigo dhoti, off-white shawl, simple beads and bangle, carrying a light-brown bamboo kingri with dark wood bow and muted red pouch.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a Pardhan bard from central India: a medium-brown skinned man with an oval face, expressive dark eyes and a calm storyteller’s smile, black hair tied into a low knot at the nape and wrapped with a narrow off-white cloth headband, a small ash-or-ochre mark on his forehead, wearing a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with fine dark-red running-stitch borders at neck, cuffs and hem, a plain handwoven dark indigo dhoti tied above the ankles with neat front pleats, and an unbleached cotton shawl with a muted indigo edge draped from his left shoulder across the chest and once around the torso; add a small dull-red cloth waist-pouch tied at his right hip, a light wooden bead necklace, a thin brass bangle on his right wrist, and simple brown leather sandals; in his left hand he gently cradles a light-brown bamboo three-string kingri with a small gourd resonator and a dark-polished wooden fingerboard, while in his right he holds a darker wooden bow with pale horsehair, and a rolled palm-leaf-wrapped bundle of story-tokens is tucked into his shawl; keep the colours to off-white, indigo, dark red, warm brown and brass-gold, and show him in neutral poses front, side and back to emphasize consistent face, hair, garments and kingri details in a clean, respectful, historically grounded style.
